amc_settings.terms_template:
1. This Annual Maintenance Contract covers preventive and breakdown maintenance of the UPS units listed in this agreement.
2. Preventive Maintenance visits will be carried out quarterly during the contract period.
3. Breakdown calls will be attended within 24 hours of intimation on working days.
4. Cost of batteries, capacitors, fans, IGBTs, SMPS cards and other consumable / faulty parts is NOT included in the AMC value unless explicitly stated.
5. Damage due to fire, flood, voltage surges beyond UPS rating, mishandling or unauthorised repairs is excluded from the contract.
6. The AMC value is payable in advance and is non-refundable once the contract is activated.
7. GST as applicable shall be charged extra.
8. Either party may terminate this contract by giving 30 days written notice.
9. Disputes, if any, are subject to Gurgaon jurisdiction only.
10. This agreement is valid only on receipt of full payment against the AMC invoice.

quote_terms_templates.body:
1. PO: Purchase Order (PO) to be released in favour of M/s Prokon Hi-Tech Systems.
2. Input/Output Wiring: Input and output power wiring/cabling, including required cables, lugs, glands, conduits/trays, etc., shall be provided by the Client, unless specifically mentioned in the quotation.
3. OEM Warranty: Warranty will be provided directly by the respective OEM as per their standard warranty terms and conditions.
4. Warranty Period: Warranty shall be applicable for the period mentioned/shown in the quotation above.
Warranty Start Date: Warranty will commence from the date of invoice.
5. Site Readiness: Installation and commissioning are subject to availability of the required electrical infrastructure, power supply and proper earthing at site.
6. Additional Work: Any civil/electrical work not specifically included in the quotation shall be in the Client's scope.
7. Unloading at Client site & Placement at site will be in Client Scope.
